final: WITH c AS (SELECT City AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Employee GROUP BY City), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c HAVING SUM(cnt) IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT c.city, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total AS ratio_sum FROM c JOIN s), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM p HAVING AVG(cnt) IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.city, p.cnt, p.ratio_sum, p.cnt * 1.0 / a.avg_cnt AS ratio_avg FROM p JOIN a
